nodes.name: world_model_actor.rs
nodes.summary: Tokio actor wrapping WorldModelEnhanced for async message-passing: defines a WorldModelMessage enum covering all world-model operations and a WorldModelActorClient struct that sends typed messages over an mpsc channel and awaits oneshot responses.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses the Tokio mpsc + oneshot channel pattern (actor model): a background task owns the WorldModelEnhanced instance and processes messages sequentially, while callers hold only a cloneable sender handle — avoiding shared mutable state across async boundaries.

nodes.name: WorldModelMessage
nodes.summary: Enum defining the full message protocol for the world-model actor: nine variants covering action recording, state-transition observation, prediction, entity management, causal graph mutations, and counterfactual queries — each carrying its payload and an optional oneshot responder.

nodes.name: WorldModelActorClient
nodes.summary: Cloneable async client handle for the world-model actor: holds the mpsc sender and exposes ten typed async methods that construct messages, open oneshot channels for responses, and await results — providing a clean interface over the underlying actor loop.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Constructs a WorldModelActorClient by creating an mpsc channel, spawning a Tokio task that owns a WorldModelEnhanced instance and dispatches incoming messages in a receive loop, then returning the client handle backed by the sender.
